caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent wine glass positioned upright in the center of the image. The glass has a slightly flared rim, a rounded bowl tapering towards the stem, a distinct node at the base of the bowl, a long and slender stem, and a broad, circular foot. The object is illustrated using fine pencil shading and highlights to convey its transparency and reflective properties. There are no other objects or background details— the entire composition consists of the centrally placed glass on a plain, off-white background. Signature markings are visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Wine Glass
